about.heading: About
about.description_1: From startup IR pitching to hackathons — 11 awards and 15 services planned, built, and shipped. Working toward becoming a planner who leads every step from idea to real users.
about.description_2: I define problems with data, design screens in Figma, and build frontends with React, TypeScript, and Next.js. Currently at SSAFY 15th cohort (Non-CS Java track) to fill gaps in exception handling, QA, and database design.
about.description_3: My goal: a PM who simultaneously ships products people actually use, makes decisions backed by data, and builds teams that grow together.
